register.labelZh: HANG 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: hang around 和 hang about 可以描述在某處等候或逗留;hang out 和 hang with 則可以描述與其他人一起消磨時間。；hang on 可以表示某個結果或決定取決於某事;hang over 則可以表示某種憂慮或危險仍未消失。；你可以 hang on to a receipt,表示保留收據;也可以 hang on to a rail,表示緊緊抓住扶手。；hang something on somebody 可以描述把責任歸咎於某人;hang together 則可以描述故事、計劃或解釋整體上是否合理連貫。
register.summaryEn: Hang around and hang about can describe waiting or staying somewhere. Hang out and hang with can describe spending time with other people. Hang on can show that a result or decision depends on something. Hang over can show that a worry or danger has not gone away. You can hang on to a receipt because you want to keep it, or hang on to a rail because you need to hold it tightly. Hang something on somebody describes blaming someone. Hang together describes a story, plan or explanation that makes sense as a whole.
